meta.description: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画，具备立体层次感、明亮温暖色调，适用于科技、教育、品牌展示等场景

copy.tagline: 生成3D纸艺弹出书风格插画
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在项目中加入立体纸艺风格的视觉元素
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to add 3D papercraft style visuals to your projects

howto.what: Claude 会根据需求生成 3D 纸艺弹出书风格插画，呈现打开的书本、多层立体结构和纸质纹理，配色以薄荷绿、天蓝、珊瑚橙、奶油黄等明亮温暖色调为主，并可按需加入霓虹光效、科技图标等数字元素。
howto.when: 当用户需要生成具有纸艺质感、立体层次和明亮温暖色调（如薄荷绿、天蓝等）的插画，或明确要求“弹出书”风格时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一张科技主题的3D纸艺弹出书插画，主体是AI大脑。
say.note: Claude 会按弹出书风格生成带霓虹光效的插画。

say.text: 用珊瑚橙和奶油黄配色，画一本弹出知识树的弹出书。
say.note: 会生成教育主题的立体插画。

say.text: 给这个品牌做一张产品展示的纸艺弹出书插画。
say.note: 生成包含品牌元素的多层立体图。

howto.what_en: Claude will generate 3D pop-up book style illustrations with layered paper textures, open book scenes, and bright warm colors (mint green, sky blue, coral orange, cream yellow), optionally blending neon glows and digital tech icons.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks for paper-craft textured, layered, bright warm-toned illustrations (e.g. mint green, sky blue) or explicitly requests a pop-up book style.

say_en.text: Draw a tech-themed 3D pop-up book illustration featuring an AI brain.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a pop-up style image with neon glows.

say_en.text: Create a pop-up book with a knowledge tree in coral orange and cream yellow.
Make a product showcase pop-up book illustration for this brand.
say_en.note: Generates a multi-layer 3D image with brand elements.
